whyOrder.heading: Why order from China through AutoRoom

features.title: Master Account support
text: Full smart-car management, right from your phone. Most functions of modern Chinese smart cars are controlled through a mobile app. With AutoRoom you get more than just a car — a complete solution, with support for Master Account access and activation.

features.title: 100% transparent pricing
text: Unlike the risks of an individual import, AutoRoom gives you a clear breakdown of the final price up front. The price includes every component — the car, logistics, insurance and customs clearance.

features.title: Professional guidance
text: Our team is guided by real numbers and technical facts. We help you find the best car within your budget based on your actual needs, not common market stereotypes.

features.title: Financial support (auto loan)
text: Your preferred car can be yours more easily. By partnering with Armenia's leading banks, we help arrange an auto loan with the most flexible, favorable rates.

features.title: Exclusive privileges
text: Extra services at prices well below market rate.
Being an AutoRoom customer pays off — through our partner network, you get special, discounted rates for your car's additional services:
PPF wrap (paint protection film) and detailing
